name: index_catalog
preconditionSql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_migrations WHERE version = '0021') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.pg_class WHERE relkind = 'i' AND relname = 'ix_company_phones__company_id') AS ok;
verificationSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_catalog.pg_class i JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid = i.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'public' AND i.relkind = 'i' AND (i.relname LIKE 'ix\\_%' ESCAPE '\\\\' OR i.relname LIKE 'ux\\_%' ESCAPE '\\\\' OR i.relname LIKE 'gin\\_%' ESCAPE '\\\\')) = 155 AS ok;
recovery: Transactional failure rolls the Phase 03.07 Index Catalog migration back. After a successful production apply, recovery remains forward-only: do not drop approved indexes or rewrite committed migration history. Any future index change requires measurement, EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), and a versioned decision.
